findings.label: Not updating

findings.about: Changes since its last release, 3 months or more ago, wait to be released.

findings.label: No licence

penalties.when: A public repository without a licence GitHub detects.

findings.about: Many open issues wait for an answer.
findings.label: Backlog

findings.label: Waiting for review

A pull request by a person idle for more than 7 days waiting for a review.

findings.label: Old updates
